categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Touches `test/functional/rpc_psbt.py` and associated test vector data to test `combinepsbt` and other PSBT RPC behavior.
categories.rationale: Adds upstream BIP 174 test vectors and verifies that `combinepsbt` produces identical output regardless of input order. While it does not fix a bug or alter RPC behavior, incorporating standard specification test vectors provides worthwhile regression coverage for the RPC interface.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches functional tests for node-level PSBT RPCs with no wallet code changes, falling under the borderline rule that assigns non-wallet PSBT/RPC changes to rpc.
categories.rationale: Wallet explicitly notes that a descriptor or PSBT change affecting only `bitcoin-tx` or RPC without wallet code is rpc, not wallet.
